_what: A person's personal keys (the keys an AI app, an agent, a script or a machine signs in with): how many one list shows, what a key may last, the expiry choices the account page offers, and the words a list or a turn-off answers with (read-data/keys-list-turn-off.mjs). A key's own value is never listed or answered; only these fields are. A sign-in reaches no further and lasts no longer than the sign-in that makes or changes a key. Ported from the earlier code base's src/personal-keys.json and src/personal-keys.mjs (b6ae0ebf815f). Making and changing a key, the storage of keys and the ending of a sign-in at the account's policy owner are not here.

words.expired: This personal key expired at {at}. Its person can extend it on their account page, or make a new key.
words.not_yours: That key is not one of this account's keys, or it is already off.
words.reaches_less: This sign-in reaches less than that key, so it cannot change or turn off that key.
words.outlives: A key cannot last longer than the sign-in that sets its expiry, which ends at {at}. Ask the person to do this on their account page.
words.bad_expiry: Give expires_in as a whole number of seconds from 1 to {max}, or expires_at as a future date and time within that, or null for a key that never expires.
words.ended: The key is off. Apps using it stop working on their next call.
